problems.memo_sentence: For a real-world fraud dataset with about 11×10^6 samples and 20 features, they provide closed-form resource estimates, including a headline fault-tolerant requirement on the order of 1.41×10^10 logical qubits and 1.16×10^14 total gates.
problems.source_evidence: To simulate the QRAM, we employ the parallel Bucket Brigade implementation [21] ... Under the above considerations and results in Tab. II, the application of the AD-QPCA algorithm to the aforementioned dataset, assuming n = 8, requires fault-tolerant quantum hardware capable of executing a circuit with O(1.41×1010) logical qubits, O(1.16 × 1014) total gate count, O(5.80 × 106) total depth, O(1.99 × 1013) T-count, and O(2.26 × 106) T-depth.
problems.explanation: The memo presents the large qubit and gate counts as unconditional headline requirements, whereas the paper explicitly states they are derived under specific modeling assumptions (particular QRAM simulation and n=8 encoding), making the quoted numbers conditional rather than absolute.
